summary: The lane's two fixes hold under my own runs. AUD-1: the frozen AudioContext clock is this Mac's output device, not the client. I reproduced it: afplay of a 1 s silent wav was still blocked at the 10 s timeout (exit 124); a bare about:blank AudioContext stayed at 0.00533 s, state running; suspend/resume and close plus a new context did not help; the real client stayed frozen at the menu, at match start and over 19.3 s of a RIFT match. On Chrome's fake sink the bare clock advanced 4.21 s in 5.18 s at load 120-420. The client created 1 context, called resume, and never called suspend, close or setSinkId. AUD-2: the sampling loop now has a wall deadline and a stall stop. probe_audio_mix ran to completion with the maps in a new order (fray, bridge, rift): exit 0, PASS, RIFT floor lift M2 3.7 dB (bar 1). probe_audio_music: exit 0, all 17 gates. Break test, 4 matches in a row in one page with real rendering (fray High, bridge Ultra, rift High, then a rift Ultra restart), casting Q/W/E/R then Esc, shop then Esc, the menu, leaving: 1 AudioContext throughout, clock rate 0.999-1.001 at every step, master never silent, every ambient emitter playing in every match, 0 page errors. typecheck exit 0; npm run -s probe 55 of 55 PASS. One open point, not a regression from this lane: probe_audio_runtime sync passed 2 of 3 runs. In run 3, hits 2-21 of 50 played no cue (startsInCall 30/50, measured 29/50) at load 400-690. The gate needs an idle machine and nothing this lane changed is on that path, but this does not confirm the engineer's 50 of 50 in every run.
